notes.1: One saucepan serves 4. The rice and liquid are measured for this size.

move.title: Measure it, toast it, leave it
move.body: Mexican rice is rice toasted in oil, then cooked in tomato and broth until it drinks up every drop. Today you'll measure the rice and liquid exactly, keep the lid on, and top it with rotisserie chicken.

why.title: The ratio
why.body: Long-grain rice takes 1½ cups of liquid for every cup of rice. The tomato sauce counts as liquid.

why.title: Toast the rice
why.body: Rice stirred in hot oil turns golden and nutty. Each grain gets a coat of oil, so it cooks up fluffy, not sticky.

why.title: Keep the lid on
why.body: The rice finishes in the steam under the lid. Lifting the lid lets the steam out.

why.title: Warm the chicken to 165°F
why.body: Cooked chicken that's been in the fridge needs to be heated to 165°F to be safe.

wrong.fix: Sprinkle on 2 tablespoons of water, put the lid back, and cook 5 more minutes on low.
There was too much liquid, or it was stirred. Measure exactly next time.
The heat was too high. Use the lowest setting under the lid.

quiz.q: How much liquid for each cup of long-grain rice?

quiz.explain: Lifting it lets the steam out.

quiz.q: How hot should the leftover chicken get?

steps.text: Rinse the rice in the colander under cold water. Swish it with your hand.
steps.tip: Shake off as much water as you can.

steps.text: Measure the tomato sauce and broth into the liquid measuring cup.
Heat the oil in the saucepan over medium heat.
Add the rice. Stir it in the oil until some grains turn golden.
steps.look: Some grains golden, and a nutty smell.

steps.text: Stir in the onion, garlic, and cumin for 1 minute.
Pour in the liquid and the salt. Stir once.
steps.tip: It hisses. Pour close to the pan.

steps.text: Let it come to a boil. Scatter the peas and carrots on top.
Put the lid on. Turn the heat to low. Don't lift the lid.
Turn off the burner. Leave the lid on.
steps.tip: Pull the chicken while it rests.

steps.text: Pull the chicken off the bones in bite-size pieces. Put 2 cups on the plate.
steps.look: Bite-size pieces, no skin or bones.
steps.tip: Keep the rest of the chicken in the fridge.

steps.text: Cover the plate and microwave the chicken until it's hot.
Push the thermometer into the thickest piece. It should read 165°F.
Fluff the rice with the fork. Top it with the chicken, lime, and cilantro.
steps.look: Fluffy orange rice with peas and carrots.
